name: transition/whip-pan-cut
title: Whip Pan Cut
desc_vi: Hai cảnh cùng lia ngang với tốc độ tăng rồi hãm, nhoè theo chiều ngang mạnh nhất giữa pha lia; vạch màu mảnh chạy trên đường nối hai cảnh.
params_vi: duration (0.55 s) · direction: left | right · accent: màu vạch · peak: độ nhoè tối đa (16 px)
notes: The source strip (both scenes on one mover) is two inners with the same power3.inOut x tween (one frame width), so seam velocity matches as in the source. The horizontal-only blur is the source's SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 'v 0' (v 0 -> 16 px over the first half, power3.in, then 16 -> 0, power3.out); it is written per frame by a small ctx.code proxy and applied to both inners with filter:url(#...) set at the start and 'none' at the end. The SVG filter lives in the incoming scene element. The seam hairline (0.35 % of width) is a box in the incoming scene element that follows the boundary (same x tween, offset by half its width), faded in over 0.1 s and out over the last 0.15 s, as in the source. The source lead-in (whip_at), exit variable and sound cue are not ported. ae is png because of the directional SVG blur.
